hook.name: EulerSwap
hook.description: A custom AMM hook that integrates Euler Finance lending vaults as the liquidity source. In beforeSwap, it computes a quote using a proprietary pricing curve, takes input tokens from the PoolManager into the Euler vault, withdraws output tokens from the opposing vault, and returns a BeforeSwapDelta to bypass standard Uniswap v4 concentrated liquidity logic. Standard add-liquidity and donate operations are blocked by design.
